> Use the **Sort** dropdown on the right of the search box. It defaults to **Newest first**; switch to **Title A–Z** and watch the list reorder alphabetically, then **Oldest first**. The sort applies within whatever you're viewing (All / To read / Archived) and works together with search and tag filters.

Two quick things to confirm:

- Does having **Newest first / Oldest first / Title A–Z / Title Z–A** cover the ways you'd want to order the list, or is there another ordering you'd reach for (for example, recently updated)?
- Is a **dropdown** next to the search the right home for this control?
